name: Financial transaction type code
description: Code specifying a type of financial transaction.

values.name: Clean payment
values.description: Clean payment Payment under open account terms.

values.name: Pre-authorised direct debit or direct debit request
values.description: Pre-authorised direct debit or direct debit request The transaction is a pre-authorised direct debit or direct debit request, i.e. a direct debit for which there is an agreed mandate that allows the creditor to draw funds from the debtor.

values.name: Non pre-authorised direct debit or direct debit request
values.description: Non pre-authorised direct debit or direct debit request The transaction is a non pre-authorised direct debit or direct debit request, i.e. a direct debit for which there is no prior agreed mandate allowing the creditor to draw funds from the debtor.

values.name: Documentary payment
values.description: Documentary payment Payment relating to a documentary settlement.

values.name: Irrevocable documentary credit
values.description: Irrevocable documentary credit The documentary credit is irrevocable.

values.name: Revocable documentary credit
values.description: Revocable documentary credit The documentary credit is revocable.

values.name: Irrevocable and transferable documentary credit
values.description: Irrevocable and transferable documentary credit The documentary credit is irrevocable and may be transferred to a second beneficiary.

values.name: Revocable and transferable documentary credit
values.description: Revocable and transferable documentary credit The documentary credit is revocable and may be transferred to a second beneficiary.

values.name: Revocable and transferable standby letter of credit
values.description: Revocable and transferable standby letter of credit Revocable and transferable standby letter of credit.

values.name: Irrevocable and transferable standby letter of credit
values.description: Irrevocable and transferable standby letter of credit Irrevocable and transferable standby letter of credit.

values.name: Revocable standby letter of credit
values.description: Revocable standby letter of credit Revocable standby letter of credit.

values.name: Irrevocable standby letter of credit
values.description: Irrevocable standby letter of credit Irrevocable standby letter of credit.

values.name: Pre-advised direct debit
values.description: Pre-advised direct debit The transaction is a direct debit about which the debtor has advised his bank prior to the creditor raising the direct debit, giving his bank permission to debit his account.

values.name: Non pre-advised direct debit
values.description: Non pre-advised direct debit The transaction is a direct debit about which the debtor has not advised his bank prior to the creditor raising the direct debit.

values.name: Irrevocable reimbursement of cash withdrawal
values.description: Irrevocable reimbursement of cash withdrawal The transaction is an irrevocable direct debit, from bank A to bank B, which reimburses bank A that has by agreement provided cash to a customer of bank B.
